raw.query: SELECT ROUND(AVG(b.mean_ms / a.mean_ms)::numeric, 4) AS speedup_ratio FROM provenance.collector_encoder_fn a JOIN provenance.collector_encoder_fn b USING (engine, image_px, n_images) WHERE a.source_path LIKE '%burst_anchor%' AND b.source_path LIKE '%fn_repro%';
raw.evidence: Pairing unlocked (burst_anchor: 2887 MHz) with locked (fn_repro: 2377-2400 MHz) data points in collector_encoder_fn yields an average speedup ratio of 1.1647 (16.5% faster), confirming the claimed ≈17% speedup.
